play a role: Good sleep and a healthy diet both play a role in helping students do well on their exams.
充足的睡眠和健康的飲食都在幫助學生考好試上扮演角色。
play it safe: Since the road was icy, my father decided to play it safe and drive slowly all the way home.
因為路面結冰，爸爸決定保守行事，一路慢慢開回家。
play by the rules: If you don't play by the rules, the coach will not let you join the next basketball game.
如果你不照規矩來，教練就不會讓你參加下一場籃球比賽。
play with fire: You are going to play with fire if you keep lying to your boss about why you are late.
如果你一直對老闆謊報遲到的原因，你就是在玩火。
play down: The company tried to play down the safety problem, but news reports soon showed how serious it really was.
公司試圖淡化這個安全問題，但新聞報導很快就揭露了它有多嚴重。
play up: To win more votes, the politician tended to play up his small successes, making them sound much bigger than they were.
為了贏得更多選票，這位政治人物常誇大自己的小成就，讓它們聽起來比實際大得多。
play for time: The thief tried to play for time by asking the police silly questions until his friends arrived.
小偷問警察一些無聊的問題，想拖延時間等同夥到來。
play into one's hands: If you lose your temper during the debate, you will only play into your opponent's hands.
如果你在辯論中發脾氣，只會正中對手下懷。
plead guilty: The driver decided to plead guilty to drunk driving, hoping the judge would give him a lighter punishment.
這名駕駛決定對酒駕認罪，希望法官能從輕發落。
plead for mercy: The young thief fell to his knees and began to plead for mercy when the shop owner called the police.
店主報警時，年輕的小偷跪了下來開始求饒。
plead ignorance: When the teacher asked who broke the window, Tom tried to plead ignorance, saying he had been in the library.
老師問是誰打破窗戶時，湯姆推說不知情，說自己當時在圖書館。
plead with someone: The little girl continued to plead with her mother to buy her the toy, but her mother still said no.
小女孩一直懇求媽媽買玩具給她，但媽媽還是拒絕了。
plead one's case: Each student was given five minutes to plead their case before the school committee made its final decision.
在學校委員會做出最後決定前，每位學生有五分鐘為自己辯護。
pledge support: After the earthquake, many countries were quick to pledge support and send rescue teams to the area.
地震過後，許多國家迅速承諾支持，並派救援隊前往災區。
pledge allegiance: In some countries, students pledge allegiance to the flag every morning before classes begin.
在某些國家，學生每天早上上課前都要向國旗宣誓效忠。
pledge money: Many fans promised to pledge money to help the singer's hometown rebuild after the terrible flood.
許多歌迷答應認捐，幫助這位歌手的家鄉在嚴重水災後重建。
pledge to cut taxes: Both candidates pledge to cut taxes during every election, but few voters believe they will keep their promises.
兩位候選人每次選舉都承諾減稅，但很少選民相信他們會兌現承諾。
pledge one's word: I pledge my word that I will pay you back the money before the end of this month.
我以名譽擔保，會在這個月底前把錢還給你。
plot a murder: In the novel, the butler and the cook secretly plot a murder because they want the rich man's money.
在這本小說裡，管家和廚師因為想要富翁的錢而暗中謀劃謀殺。
plot a course: Before sailing, the captain used maps and the stars to plot a course across the ocean to the island.
出航前，船長用地圖和星星規劃橫越大洋前往小島的航線。
plot the data: After the experiment, the students had to plot the data on a graph to show how the temperature changed.
實驗結束後，學生們必須把數據繪製成圖，呈現溫度如何變化。
plot against the king: In the story, the king's own brother began to plot against the king in order to take his throne.
在故事中，國王的親弟弟為了奪取王位，開始密謀反抗國王。
the plot thickens: The police found a second key in the victim's car, and the plot thickens as the detective questions the maid.
警方在被害人車上找到第二把鑰匙，隨著偵探盤問女傭，事情越來越複雜。
plug the gap: The company hired five new engineers to plug the gap left by the workers who had quit last month.
公司僱用了五名新工程師，來填補上個月離職員工留下的缺口。
plug a product: The famous actor appeared on many talk shows to plug a product, praising it again and again so fans would buy it.
這位知名演員上了許多談話節目大力宣傳產品，一再稱讚它好讓粉絲購買。
plug in: Remember to plug in your phone before you go to bed, or the battery will be dead tomorrow morning.
睡前記得把手機插電，不然明天早上電池就沒電了。
pull the plug on: The TV station decided to pull the plug on the show because fewer and fewer people were watching it.
電視台決定終止這個節目，因為收看的人越來越少。
plug a leak: The plumber came quickly to plug a leak in the kitchen pipe before the water damaged the floor.
水電工很快趕來堵住廚房水管的漏水，以免水損壞地板。
